info.title: Deqio Decision Server
info.description: Deqio — decision in, probabilities out. Portable routes (`/v1/noul`, `/v1/choice`, `/v1/shared`) return the cross-model Deqio contract with Decision Provenance / Attestation (`provenance`, including `provider`, `remote_request_id` and `cost_estimate`); native routes (`/v1/score`, `/v1/multi`, `/v1/act`, `/v1/soam`, `/v1/systemone`) return the active profile's native System One reply plus a `deqio` block. `/v1/decision` is the `/v1/choice` alias. The Python SDK `deqio-client` and `deqio decide` call these routes.

post.description: The canonical native System One contract of the active profile.

503.description: The runtime is still loading, or inference is suspended while a benchmark owns it.

parameters.name: Deqio-Contract
parameters.description: Negotiates the input-completeness contract: the exact body bytes are hashed, duplicate JSON keys are rejected, explicit stable ids and an `input_policy` are required, and the response carries `input_receipt`/`usage` with attestation schema v2. Unknown versions are rejected with 422.

TypedSystemOneRequest.title: TypedSystemOneRequest
TypedSystemOneRequest.description:
Convenience request for one native SystemOne question.

The endpoint injects the decision type (score/multi/act); every other
question field is forwarded unchanged to the active native runtime.

Attestation.description: Local, unsigned response binding (Attestation v1/v2): not a cryptographic signature or a remote trust proof.
Attestation.title: Attestation

CostEstimate.description: Estimated price of one remote call from the API's reported input tokens and the published input price. Never a bill.

amount.description: `null` when the API did not report usage.
amount.title: Amount

basis.description: What the amount is computed from, e.g. `input_tokens`.
basis.title: Basis

scope.description: `decision` for one result, `batch` for a whole `/v1/shared` call.
scope.title: Scope

CostEstimate.title: CostEstimate

DecisionProvenance.description: Decision Provenance / Attestation for one portable result.

schema_version.description: 1, or 2 when the `input-completeness-v1` contract was negotiated.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

remote_request_id.description: The remote API's request id, `null` for local engines or when not reported.
remote_request_id.title: Remote Request Id

DecisionProvenance.title: DecisionProvenance

ProviderDescriptor.description: Who answered: the local sidecar of the active profile, or the remote decision API behind a `remote` profile.

model.description: Remote model identifier typed at `deqio models setup` (remote providers).
model.title: Model

ProviderDescriptor.title: ProviderDescriptor

RuntimeIdentity.description: The loaded runtime captured under the same inference lock as the score.
RuntimeIdentity.title: RuntimeIdentity

ScoreProvenance.description: How the probabilities were produced: engine-reported, a Deqio transform, or a synthetic fallback — never hidden.
ScoreProvenance.title: ScoreProvenance

DecisionResponse.description: `/v1/noul`, `/v1/choice`, `/v1/decision`: one decision with probabilities over the option ids (`yes`/`no` for noul).

option_logits.description: Raw logits when the engine exposes them, otherwise empty.
option_logits.title: Option Logits

DecisionResponse.title: DecisionResponse

SharedProvenance.description: Batch-level provenance of `/v1/shared`: the same runtime instance bound to every result.

cost_estimate.description: Batch-scoped (`scope: batch`) when a remote API answered the whole batch.

SharedProvenance.title: SharedProvenance

DeqioNativeBlock.description: Deqio's block on native responses: runtime identity, timing and the provider.
DeqioNativeBlock.title: DeqioNativeBlock

SystemOneAnswer.description:
One native answer. `choice`/`probabilities` for choice, `noul` for noul, `score`/`legend` for score, and the
engine's own fields for multi/act — preserved unchanged from the runtime.
SystemOneAnswer.title: SystemOneAnswer

SystemOneResponse.description:
`/v1/score`, `/v1/multi`, `/v1/act`, `/v1/soam`, `/v1/systemone`: the native System One reply plus `deqio`.
Upstream fields other than `model`, `answers` and `usage` are preserved as the runtime returned them.
SystemOneResponse.title: SystemOneResponse

HTTPErrorResponse.description:
Rejections raised by a handler: validation before inference, a capability the active profile lacks (422),
a runtime that is loading or suspended (503), a protocol failure (502).

detail.description: A message, or FastAPI's list of body-validation errors.
detail.title: Detail

HTTPErrorResponse.title: HTTPErrorResponse

ContractErrorResponse.description: Rejections of the negotiated `Deqio-Contract` body (unknown version, duplicate keys, missing policy).
ContractErrorResponse.title: ContractErrorResponse
